history.overview: The Lair was once a prison chamber for Dragorn exiles, later corrupted by Discord energy.

timeline.name: Exile Era
timeline.description: Dragorn prisoners were abandoned in these chambers.

timeline.name: Muramite Abuse
timeline.description: Muramite inquisitors used the lair as a dumping ground for captives.

timeline.name: Discord Torment
timeline.description: Discord energy twisted the trapped into horrors and tormented spirits.

timeline.name: Resistance Recon
timeline.description: Dragorn rebels attempted infiltration but found the lair too dangerous.
